raw: “I felt sad when my sister was moving to another country. Her suitcases were packed before the weekend, but having one last breakfast together at the station made it feel real to me. I was sitting there with her, thinking about how she was leaving and how much I would miss her. It was an ordinary thing—having breakfast together—but knowing it was our last one before she went made it feel different. I wanted to enjoy being with her, but I kept thinking about having to say goodbye.”
